endorsements.name: Tushar Dalvi
endorsements.label: QARK: Android App Exploit and SCA Tool
endorsements.description: Ever wonder why there isn't a metasploit-style framework for Android apps? We did! Whether you're a developer trying to protect your insecure app from winding up on devices, an Android n00b or a pentester trying to pwn all the things, QARK is just what you've been looking for! This tool combines SCA, teaching and automated exploitation into one, simple to use application!
